data.one_liner: Wheel-shaped picker widget for Flutter with customizable headers, overlays, and 3D effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slot-style wheel picker widget for selecting values from a list. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations, form field integration, custom item builders, looping, and programmatic control via controllers.
use_when: You need a wheel-shaped date, time, or custom option picker in your Flutter app
You require horizontal or vertical slot-style scrolling choices with 3D magnifier effects
You need form field integration with built-in validation for wheel selections
avoid_when: You need a standard dropdown or popup menu instead of a rolling drum interface
Your dataset is extremely large and unstructured where a search filter input is more appropriate
strengths: High performance with isolated reactive item rendering avoiding parent rebuilds
Supports both finite and looping scrolling modes with horizontal and vertical orientations
Includes form integration via WheelChoiceFormField and programmatic control through WheelController
weaknesses: Keyboard navigation and haptic feedback features are marked as experimental
Loop mode instantiates all children upfront, making it less suitable for very large circular datasets
